ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast; approximately 70% high-intensity white pixels and 30% low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity white field on the left lobe. A central, irregular low-intensity black plume extends from the notch area toward the mid-fluke region. Small, discrete low-intensity spots (mottling) are dispersed across the white regions. A continuous low-intensity black border outlines the trailing edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 75 degrees and a bounding-box depth of approximately 120 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations along the trailing edge; characterized by jagged peaks and valleys with pixel amplitudes between 5 and 20 pixels, most prominent on the distal portions of the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edge of the left lobe follows a broad convex trajectory; the right lobe exhibits a sharp downward concave curl where it meets the water surface.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of small, low-intensity circular pixel groups located in the lower-central region of the white left lobe field.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A distinct vertical linear disruption (darker pixel values) located on the left lobe, approximately midway between the median notch and the outer tip.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible parallel vertical rake marks on the left lobe; significant irregular traumatic serrations along the trailing edge indicating historical tissue removal.
other_distinctive_markers: A unique hook-shaped dark pigment marking located in the upper-left quadrant of the high-intensity white region on the left lobe.
